scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 65 km this is Simplon Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-swiss-alps-jungfrau-aletsch-monte.story: A 369 km round trip from Fiesch - roughly 6 h 22 in the saddle. It goes by way of Sacro Monte Calvario, Sacro Monte della SS.Trinità, Mercurago and Monte San Giorgio. The highest point is about 2,350 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
